simple.meaning: שָׁאַב (shâʼab) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to bale up water.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 19 times across Genesis, Deuteronomy, Joshua, Ruth, 1 Samuel, and 4 more, beginning at Genesis 24:11. Its contexts include family line, kingship, city.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שָׁאַב (H7579).
